senses.gloss: f. (preced.) entanglement, tangles and scabs formed through uncleanliness.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 81a:1">Ned. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ דרישא מיתיא וכ׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="H01744"><he>חרפופיתא</he></cite>) tangles of the head cause blindness; <he>ע׳ דמאני</he> scabs arising from neglected clothes; <he>ע׳ דגופא</he> from neglect of the body.

<cite ref="Nedarim 81a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>צערא דע׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 787:9">Yalk. Num. 787</cite> <he>דחיפופיתא</he>) the suffering caused by scabs &c.—Pl. <cite ref="P01270"><he>עִרְבּוּבְיָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 787:9">Ib.</cite> <he>הזהרו בע׳</he> be on your guard against the consequences of uncleanliness.
